annotations.title: Generate an ad for a brand segment

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Builds a segment's ad script as beats (hook, persona, offer, proof, CTA) from the owner's own words, or checks the `beats` you edited. Every beat is claims-checked and any figure must come from the segment's offer, outcomes or proof (nothing is invented). Without `render` it returns { segment, script, issues, claims, variants } and stores nothing. `variants` are per-network proposals (TikTok, X, Pinterest, Reddit by default, or `networks`): the ad text cut to that network's cap from whole beats, the planned length and the ad-cut lint of the planned cut, with `ready`. Proposals only: nothing is booked or spent. With `render: true`, `contentId` (a Library card of the same brand) and a clean script it queues a free, silent 9:16 motion ad and returns a jobId (voice is not added yet). Saves a draft; nothing is posted.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/video-studio/segment-ads.)

beats.description: `{ role: hook|persona|offer|proof|cta, text }`, hook first and CTA last. Omit to use the generated script.

contentId.description: The card, a Library image of this brand. Needed to render.

networks.description: Network ids for the `variants` proposals. Default: the configured list.

render.description: Queue the render. Default false: preview only.
